camera.note: one camera and one key light for every sprite; night is a 2D tint in the game

units.note: frame sizes, anchors and footprints are in 1x px; the 2x atlas holds the same frames at exactly twice the size. A grid cell is 32 px wide and cellDepthPx1x px tall on screen (ground depth is foreshortened by sin 52 deg); screen y = ground y * cellDepthPx1x / 32 - height * heightPxPerUnit1x

place.teahouse.note: tea flag on the right; windows are dim by day

place.tavern.note: wine flag on the left; the household of nobody, so no door lanterns

place.bridge.deckLiftNote: screen lift of a walker on the deck, sampled every half cell from the west end (index 0) to the east end (index 12); the span is 6 cells, the canal under it 4 cells wide and centred

place.bridge_broken.deckLiftNote: screen lift of a walker on the deck, sampled every half cell from the west end (index 0) to the east end (index 12); the span is 6 cells, the canal under it 4 cells wide and centred

prop.elder_seal.note: a stone seal with the character 族 cut in its face; for the corner of the page, not for the map

prop.notebook.note: a thread-bound book lying flat, 见闻簿 on its label; for the corner of the page, not for the map

prop.incense_unlit.note: a bronze burner with a stick of incense; stands on the same point as prop.incense_lit

prop.incense_lit.note: the same burner with the tip glowing and a thread of smoke; stands on the same point as prop.incense_unlit

fx.lantern_glow.note: additive halo: draw it centred on the lantern body (door_lantern_lit anchor + glowOffsetPx), 1x radius 64 px

fx.windows.teahouse.note: added to the picture at night, anchored like its building; spots = the windows as [x, y, w, h] from the anchor of this sprite (1x px, y down), for a halo round each
